verses.1: And the LORD said to Abraham, “Go from your land, from your family, and from the house of your father, to the land that I will show you.”
verses.2: And I will make you a great nation. I will bless you, and I will exalt your name. May it be blessed.
verses.3: May I bless you and honor you, O Lord. May all the families of the earth bless you in your name.
verses.4: And Abraham went away as God had commanded him. Abraham was five years and seventy days old when he left Harran.
verses.5: And Abraham took his wife Sarai, his son Lot, and all their possessions that they had acquired. They also took their livestock with them. Then they set out to go to the land of Canaan. So they arrived in the land of Canaan.
verses.6: And Abraham traveled through the land until he reached a place called Shechem. There, the Canaanites lived at that time.
verses.7: And Jehovah saw Abraham and said to his descendants, “I will give you this land. There, you shall build an altar for the visible God.”
verses.8: And from there, the mountain was brought down to Bethel. The tent of God was built there by the sea. And there, a altar was built for Jehovah. It was called “Yehova”.
verses.9: And Abraham went forth, traveling along the desert.
verses.10: There was a famine in the land. Abraham went down from Egypt to live there, because of the severity of the famine in the land.
verses.11: And when he was about to enter Egypt, he said to his wife, “Please, know that I know there’s a beautiful woman there.”
verses.12: And it would be like the Egyptians seeing you, and they would say, “This is her husband.” Then they would kill me and save you.
verses.13: I say, please do this for me, so that I may be happy through you. May my soul live because of you.
verses.14: And when Abraham entered Egypt, the Egyptians saw that woman and thought she was extremely beautiful.
verses.15: And the servants of Pharaoh saw her, and they praised her to Pharaoh. Then the woman was taken away from Pharaoh’s house.
verses.16: And Abraham was good at providing for his family. He had sheep, cattle, servants, wives, concubines, and slaves.
verses.17: And Jehovah struck Pharaoh with great blows, and his house was destroyed because of the words of Abram’s daughter.
verses.18: And Pharaoh called for Abram and said, “What have you done to me? Why didn’t you tell me that your wife was also with you?”
verses.19: Why did you say, “My sister, he will take her as his wife.” Now, here is your wife. Go ahead and take her with you.
verses.20: The king ordered that people be sent to capture him, along with his wife and all those who belonged to him.
